disposition.target: Recovery Workbench Error and Message Standard v4
disposition.change: Add message IDs for 401 no session, for 404 where the notice is absent or the data contract does not return the party, and for 409 where the notice is not sent or a dispute is already open. MSG-P4-003 fits only the out-of-scope 404.
disposition.note: Standard v4 message table has no ID for 401, for absent or unreturned 404, or for 409. MSG-P4-003 (outside role scope) fits only the out-of-scope case. Story keeps its placeholders.
Data Classification v5 DF-LEG-030 person_key and DF-LEG-032 hold_reason are the personal-data fields of rwb_comms the story touches; named in 12.1 and neither is in the answer.

edits.old: and no field that carries a name, an address, an identity number or free text of a person.
edits.new: and no field that carries a name, an address, an identity number or free text of a person. The Dispute body and the Request hold no field that Data Classification and Personal Data Inventory v5 classes as personal data. The personal data that the service reads or writes inside rwb_comms is notice.person_key (DF-LEG-030, indirect identifier) and notice.hold_reason (DF-LEG-032, Customer data), the second written in step 8 of section 4; neither is returned in the answer.
